fusions.name: Smothering Sheet
fusions.desc: A sheet thrown on a gust that deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cloak Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps your cloak round in a full turn that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, and you move 10% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Sail
fusions.desc: Carries you 2 tiles forward and increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 8%.

fusions.name: Streaming Pennant
fusions.desc: Conjures a streaming pennant: you move 5% faster, your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, and each kill returns 3 health.
